sloka: विद्यते गोषु सम्पन्नम् विद्यते ज्ञातितो भयम् ।विद्यते स्त्रीषु चापल्यम् विद्यते ज्ञातितो भयम् ॥६-१६-९॥।।
transliteration: vidyate goṣu sampannam vidyate jñātito bhayam ।vidyate strīṣu cāpalyam vidyate jñātito bhayam ॥6-16-9॥।।

translations.english: "In the cows' wealth is present, in the brahmins forbearance is seen, in the women capriciousness exists but in close relatives fear is present."
